name: Windows App
author: Microsoft Corporation
summary: Your gateway to Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Microsoft Dev Box, Remote Desktop Services, and remote PCs, securely connecting you to Windows devices and apps on a device of your choice.
description:
Windows App is your gateway to Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Microsoft Dev Box, Remote Desktop Services, and remote PCs, securely connecting you to Windows devices and apps.
You can use Windows App on many different types of devices on different platforms and form factors, such as desktops and laptops, tablets, smartphones, and through a web browser. When using a web browser on a desktop or laptop, you can connect without having to download and install any software.

versions.release_notes:
- The new connection experience in Windows App for Windows is now in public preview. To learn more, see New connection experience on Windows (preview).
- Microsoft Intune mobile application management (MAM) for Windows App on Windows is now in public preview. To learn more, see Require device security compliance for Windows App with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra Conditional Access.
- Improved app close behavior to help ensure Windows App exits cleanly.
- Improved reliability when opening Connection Center while another connection window is already open.
- Improved sign-in experience for organization-managed accounts after signing out and signing back in.
- Improved connection setup reliability by refining endpoint discovery during connection startup.
- Improved reliability for organization-managed accounts to reduce interruptions after extended use or when reopening the app.

Note
This version replaced the Insider versions 2.0.1587.0, 2.0.1592.0, and 2.0.1595.0. Changes noted above reflect all changes for these versions.
- Fixed an issue in versions 2.0.1482.0 and 2.0.1484.0 affecting drive redirection for Azure Virtual Desktop resources when configured to redirect drives connected later or specific drive letters.

- Remote PC connections is now generally available.
- Fixed an issue where endpoint reachability health checks could incorrectly report failures when running behind an authenticated proxy.
- Improved connection reliability by addressing issues that could cause remote sessions to disconnect or close unexpectedly.
- Improved diagnostics when reconnecting to a remote session.
Note
This version replaced the Insider version 2.0.1478.0. Changes noted above reflect all changes for these versions.

- Fixed an issue where Windows App could switch back to the system theme after signing out instead of preserving the selected app theme.
- Fixed an issue where the policy to skip the first-run experience might not take effect.
- Fixed an issue where Windows App could crash on Windows Server 2019 when opened while offline.
- Fixed an issue where launching an Enterprise or Flex Cloud PC from the web client could open Windows App instead of starting the connection directly.
- Fixed an issue where window control text, such as Minimize, could appear at an incorrect size after changing display resolution or moving Windows App between monitors.
- Fixed an issue where Conditional Access claim challenges could fail with error 65002.
- Fixed an issue affecting Windows 365 Boot Shared Mode that could prevent users from successfully completing sign-out.
- Shared mode for Windows 365 Boot now signs users out when sessions are disconnected.

- Stability and performance improvements for Windows 365 Boot.
- Improved handling of networks requiring captive portal in Windows 365 Boot.
- Improved handling of auto-reconnect to remote sessions when undocking from a docking station and changing display configurations and network for Windows 365 Boot.
- Improved client logging, diagnostics, and error classification to help admins troubleshoot connection and feed issues.

- Fixed an issue where updates for versions 2.0.964.0, 2.0.1069.0, and 2.0.1070.0 may not succeed when Microsoft Store updates have been disabled. To resolve the issue, a one time manual update to this version or higher is required.

- Added support for more specific URLs in the endpoint reachability health check.
- Fixed an issue with a URL in health checks that caused a warning for all users in government clouds.
- Fixed an issue that caused Windows 365 Boot sessions to end unexpectedly when Windows App udpates.

- To simplify the experience, the Connect button was removed and connections can now be initiated by clicking anywhere on a device card.
- Fixed an issue where enabling Start menu integration could cause Windows App to crash when logging locally.
- Fixed an issue where remote desktops and apps were not displaying for some Azure Government customers.
- Support for Azure Virtual Desktop in Microsoft Azure China operated by 21Vianet in public preview.

- Connection information for RemoteApp sessions can now be accessed in the System Tray.
- Windows App resources now integrate with the Start Menu.
- Added support for connections to resources in Azure Government.

- Fixed an issue that caused potential account conflict with Task View and pin to taskbar connections.
- CVE-2025-58718

Note
This version replaced the Insider version 2.0.755.0. Changes noted above reflect all changes for these versions.

- Added support for health checks, a diagnostic platform designed to proactively identify and resolve issues on end-user devices, improving reliability and performance.
- Added support for auto logoff. For more information see, Configure auto logoff on Windows.
- Improved client logging, diagnostics, and error classification to help admins troubleshoot connection and feed issues.
- Support for Windows 365 Cloud Apps is now in public preview.
- Support for Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 1809.

- Support for Windows 365 Reserve is now in limited public preview.
- Added the Session ID to the settings panel for enhanced troubleshooting and diagnostics.
- Added support for Private Link for Azure Virtual Desktop.
- Fixed an issue with update checks from the Microsoft Store where enabled.
- Fixed an issue that caused a crash when switching accounts.
- Fixed an issue that caused a crash in the client.
- Fixed a UI issue that caused misalignment on the devices and apps pages.
- Fixed an issue that caused a bloated virtual registry hive, causing latency in the app.

Note
This version replaced the Insider version 2.0.655.0. Changes noted above reflect all changes for these versions.

- Improved the disconnect experience by automatically dismissing disconnect errors after 5 minutes.
- Improved mouse latency for connections to single-user VMs.
- Removed redundant logging to reduce network traffic and produce cleaner logs.
- Fixed an issue where the session appeared to freeze when using drive redirection.
- Addressed an issue that could cause multiple authentication prompts when connecting to a resource.
- Fixed an issue that caused a crash when connecting.
- Fixed an issue that caused a crash when switching to a new account.
- Fixed an issue that caused a crash when the app starts.
- Support for Entra Token Protection is now generally available
- Support for External identity (preview).
- Added support for network proxy.

Note
This version replaced the Insider versions 2.0.631.0, and 2.0.632.0. Changes noted above reflect all changes for these versions.
- Fixes for CVE-2025-29967.

- Fixed an issue for CVE-2025-26645.
- Improve start up time of RemoteApps.

- Support automatic updates in environments that block the Microsoft Store or have disabled automatic updates from the Microsoft Store. Minimum installed version must be 2.0.327.0 or higher to receive automatic updates.
- Fixed a bug that caused the app to crash.
- Improved update experience with banner notification when manually updating the app.
- Additional improvements to app startup time.
- Identify resource discovery issues with a toast notification in the app.
- Fixed a bug that caused issues with the account switcher.
- Bring already running Windows App instance to foreground when another instance is launched.
- Added support to optimize screen and app sharing.
- Resolved an issue with keyboard shortcut CTRL+ALT+Arrow in a RemoteApp scenario.
- Improved the session relaunch experience, removing the requirement that the previous session fully processes telemetry before the next session launches.
Note
This version replaced the Insider version 2.0.336.0 and 2.0.355.0. Changes noted above reflect all changes for these versions.

- Fixed an issue for CVE-2024-49105.
- Improved start up time of Windows App.
- Added list of graphics codecs to the Connection Information dialog.
- Fixed an issue where the bottom portion of the Windows Authentication dialog could be cut off when connected to a RemoteApp.
- Fixed an issue where the Connection Information dialog showed the lowest round-trip time (RTT) instead of average RTT.
- Fixed an issue where UDP type was incorrectly reported as "UDP (Private Network)" for all UDP connections in the Connection Info dialog.
- Fixed an issue with accessing display settings for Frontline shared mode devices.
- Fixed an issue where forgotten accounts displayed again after closing and reopening the app.
- Added support for most Windows OS Proxy Settings. For more information, see Known issues and limitations of Windows App.
